---
title: "03 — Two-Way Fixed-Effects Panel Models"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(plm)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

panel_df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "analysis_panel_2017_2023.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

distance_tags <- c("0_5mi", "1mi", "2mi")
outcomes <- c(
  "rent_afford",
  "rent_burden_30p",
  "rent_burden_50p"
)

required_columns <- c(
  "GEO_ID", "Year", outcomes, "poverty_hh_per",
  paste0("WithinBuffer_", distance_tags),
  paste0("PointCount_", distance_tags)
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(panel_df))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

## Prepare the balanced panel and EV-exposure transformations

```{r prepare-panel}
panel_df <- panel_df |>
  transmute(
    across(everything()),
    GEO_ID = as.character(GEO_ID),
    cbg_id = GEO_ID,
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    MedianRent = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(MedianRent)),
    MedianHouseholdIncome =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(MedianHouseholdIncome)),
    rent_afford = if_else(
      !is.na(rent_afford),
      rent_afford,
      if_else(
        MedianRent > 0 & MedianHouseholdIncome > 0,
        MedianRent / MedianHouseholdIncome,
        NA_real_
      )
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(cbg_id, Year, .keep_all = TRUE)

balanced_ids <- panel_df |>
  count(cbg_id, name = "n_years") |>
  filter(n_years == length(2017:2023)) |>
  pull(cbg_id)

panel_df <- panel_df |>
  filter(cbg_id %in% balanced_ids) |>
  arrange(cbg_id, Year) |>
  group_by(cbg_id) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(paste0("PointCount_", distance_tags)),
      ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0("WithinBuffer_", distance_tags)),
      ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0("PointCount_", distance_tags)),
      log1p,
      .names = "log{.col}"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0("PointCount_", distance_tags)),
      ~ .x - lag(.x),
      .names = "d{.col}"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("dPointCount_"),
      ~ pmax(.x, 0),
      .names = "newAdds_{sub('^dPointCount_', '', .col)}"
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("dPointCount_"),
      ~ log1p(pmax(.x, 0)),
      .names = "logNewAdds_{sub('^dPointCount_', '', .col)}"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      matches(
        "^(WithinBuffer|PointCount|dPointCount|logPointCount|logNewAdds)_"
      ),
      list(
        lead2 = ~ dplyr::lead(.x, 2),
        lag2 = ~ dplyr::lag(.x, 2)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

pdata <- pdata.frame(
  panel_df,
  index = c("cbg_id", "Year")
)

clustered_vcov <- function(model) {
  vcovHC(
    model,
    type = "HC1",
    method = "arellano",
    cluster = "group"
  )
}
```

## Model runner

```{r model-runner}
extract_ev_terms <- function(
    coefficient_test,
    ev_terms,
    outcome,
    model_id,
    ev_base,
    include_income) {

  if (is.null(coefficient_test) || nrow(coefficient_test) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      outcome = outcome,
      model_id = model_id,
      ev_base = ev_base,
      include_income = include_income,
      term = ev_terms,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std_error = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  coefficient_table <- tibble(
    term = rownames(coefficient_test),
    estimate = coefficient_test[, 1],
    std_error = coefficient_test[, 2],
    p_value = coefficient_test[, 4]
  )

  tibble(term = ev_terms) |>
    left_join(coefficient_table, by = "term") |>
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome,
      model_id = model_id,
      ev_base = ev_base,
      include_income = include_income
    ) |>
    select(
      outcome, model_id, ev_base, include_income,
      term, estimate, std_error, p_value
    )
}

run_twfe_model <- function(outcome, ev_base, include_income) {
  controls <- c(
    "TotalPopulation",
    "black_per", "hispanic_per", "asian_per",
    "hs_per", "bachelor_per", "master_per",
    "renter_per", "poverty_hh_per"
  )

  if (include_income) {
    controls <- c(controls, "MedianHouseholdIncome")
  }

  ev_terms <- c(
    paste0(ev_base, "_lead2"),
    ev_base,
    paste0(ev_base, "_lag2")
  )

  formula <- reformulate(
    c(ev_terms, controls),
    response = outcome
  )

  model_id <- paste(
    ev_base,
    ifelse(include_income, "withIncome", "noIncome"),
    outcome,
    sep = "__"
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    plm(
      formula,
      data = pdata,
      model = "within",
      effect = "twoways"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(
      extract_ev_terms(
        NULL, ev_terms, outcome, model_id,
        ev_base, include_income
      )
    )
  }

  coefficient_test <- tryCatch(
    coeftest(model, vcov. = clustered_vcov(model)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  extract_ev_terms(
    coefficient_test,
    ev_terms,
    outcome,
    model_id,
    ev_base,
    include_income
  )
}
```

## Run the model grid

```{r run-grid}
ev_variables <- c(
  paste0("WithinBuffer_", distance_tags),
  paste0("PointCount_", distance_tags),
  paste0("dPointCount_", distance_tags),
  paste0("logPointCount_", distance_tags),
  paste0("logNewAdds_", distance_tags)
)

model_grid <- expand_grid(
  outcome = outcomes,
  ev_base = ev_variables,
  include_income = c(FALSE, TRUE)
)

twfe_results <- pmap_dfr(
  model_grid,
  run_twfe_model
) |>
  mutate(
    timing = case_when(
      str_ends(term, "_lead2") ~ "Lead (t+2)",
      str_ends(term, "_lag2") ~ "Lag (t-2)",
      TRUE ~ "Current"
    ),
    significant_05 = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05,
    conf_low = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
    conf_high = estimate + 1.96 * std_error
  )

write_csv(
  twfe_results,
  here("results", "tables", "twfe_full_results.csv")
)
```

## Export compact timing and significant-results tables

```{r export-tables}
timing_wide <- twfe_results |>
  select(
    outcome, ev_base, include_income, timing,
    estimate, std_error, p_value
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timing,
    values_from = c(estimate, std_error, p_value)
  )

significant_results <- twfe_results |>
  filter(significant_05) |>
  arrange(outcome, ev_base, include_income, timing)

write_csv(
  timing_wide,
  here("results", "tables", "twfe_timing_results_wide.csv")
)
write_csv(
  significant_results,
  here("results", "tables", "twfe_significant_results.csv")
)

twfe_results |>
  count(outcome, timing, significant_05)
```
